Subject: Fwd: Fintegrate discovery — post-call recap & next steps

David / Sean,

Quick recap from today's discovery with Fintegrate (Carlos + Maya + their procurement lead on the line). High-level: strong product alignment for their RM/ALM use case; primary asks are latency at scale, on-prem/private deployment options, and SOC 2 + DPA for procurement.

Notes/highlights:
- Economic buyer: Carlos Rivera (VP Product) — cares about measurable latency and TCO; wants cost-per-session estimates for 50k monthly sessions.
- Exec sponsor: Maya Singh (Head of Finance) — concerned about data residency and vendor risk; asked for a steering committee meeting with execs and procurement present.
- Security/Procurement: they will require SOC 2 report, DPA, and a short evidence bundle; procurement contact likely Anne Procure (anne.procure@fintegrate.com).
- Decision criteria: 1) latency guarantees for 99th pct, 2) isolation/data handling (VPC/on-prem options), 3) unit economics at target scale, 4) SSO + audit logs.

Suggested next step: run a 60–90 minute steering committee with exec sponsor + procurement + product + CTO. We should come prepared with: 1) 10-min exec summary (value / savings), 2) product demo & architecture (David), 3) onboarding & support/SLA plan (Sean).

Proposed date windows (PT):
- Tue 2026-09-08 09:00–10:30
- Wed 2026-09-09 11:00–12:30
- Thu 2026-09-10 14:00–15:30

I've attached the raw post-call notes and a draft agenda for the steering committee. Can you both review and add any asks or necessary attendees? Also flag any compliance evidence we should prepare in advance.

Attachments: Fintegrate_steering_committee_agenda.pdf, post_call_notes.md

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Thanks for the notes, Marissa. Good call. A few additions:

- Suggested internal attendees: CTO (technical sponsor), Head of Data (for model ops/infra questions), Solutions Engineer (to demo). We should keep the group small at exec level — Maya + Carlos + Procurement + CTO should be fine.
- Contract lead: confirm Anne Procure as the procurement reviewer. If they want SOC 2 evidence, we can provide the SOC 2 Type II report + DPA + a short evidence pack (SOC2_evidence_overview.zip) but let's confirm what specific controls they want.
- Decision criteria — add 'time-to-live / rollout schedule' as an explicit checkbox; they care about pilot ramp and migration plan.

I'll draft a one-slide exec summary for the meeting (value, cost model, contract asks). If we aim for 09/08 morning, I can prep the demo and performance numbers aligned to their load profile.

-David
